documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Notice Calling The 1St Extra-Ordinary General Meeting For FY 2026-27 Scheduled To Be Held On Wednesday, 18Th November, 2026.
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('SEBI LODR') For Grant Of Options Under Sky Gold Limited - Employee Stock Option Plan 2024 ('SKY GOLD - ESOP 2024')
Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September 2026 And The Limited Review Report Thereon.

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q1 FY27, with consolidated revenue growing 78% year-on-year to INR2,013 crores and operating PAT crossing INR100 crores for the first time. Management highlighted improvements in gross margins driven by a shift toward Advance Gold and higher-margin non-22 KT and studded jewelry segments, alongside positive operating cash flow generation of approximately INR30 crores. The company remains on track with its long-term strategic roadmap, including Vision 2030 targets and international expansion initiatives such as initial traction in the U.K. market. Furthermore, management announced the adoption of a zero-salary promoter compensation model starting in FY27 to align interests with shareholders.

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track to achieve its aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company revised its FY27 revenue projection upwards to approximately 8,100 crore.
Management expects the EBITDA margin for FY27 to be in the range of 7.0% to 7.5%.
guidance.quote: • EBITDA margin expected in the range of ~7.0-7.5%

guidance.claim: PAT margin for FY27 is guided at 4.5% to 4.75%.
By FY30, revenue is expected to reach approximately 18,000 to 19,000 crore.
The company targets a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35% and a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Target growth metrics. We are targeting a sustainable revenue CAGR of 30% to 35%, projecting a PAT of INR945 crores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management stated that top line expansion is intentionally capped at 30% to 35% to further strengthen the balance sheet.
guidance.quote: Therefore, top line expansion is intentionally capped at 30% to 35% to further strengthening the balance sheet.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030.
guidance.quote: While these levers offer strong upside, we have guided for a conservative 5.25% PAT margin by FY2030, which represents an expansion of 75 basis points from current levels.

demand_outlook.claim: The company built a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets following an exhibition in London.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower karatage products like 18 KT, 14 KT, and 9 KT have been gaining market share due to gold price appreciation.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that B2B focused manufacturing captured peak wedding and festive demand through higher production volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Unlike several industry peers, Sky Gold's B2B focused manufacturing model effectively captured peak wedding and festive demand through higher production volumes.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that retail gold exchange has gone up from 20% to over 40%.
demand_outlook.quote: We have heard that at the retail level, the gold exchange has gone up from 20% to 40% above.

capex_expansion.claim: Future facility expansion after 2028 is expected to require an estimated capex of INR80 crores to INR100 crores on a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing footprint is planned to expand to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: • Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its Dubai office by onboarding an experienced team.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also bolstered our Dubai office by onboarding an experienced team which will enhance our ability to serve and grow across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 from 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased from 10.5% in Q4 FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

margins_costs.claim: The share of studded jewelry increased from 1.65% in Q4 FY26 to 2.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The share of studded jewelry has also increased from 1.65% in Q4 '26 to 2.1% in Q1 '27, on account of management's focus on better-margin products.

margins_costs.claim: Value-Added share of business has surged from under 10% in FY23 to roughly 50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: • Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has surged from <10% in FY23 to ~50-55% in FY26, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gold loss was reduced from 1.5% to a lean 0.5% through the implementation of an ERP system.
margins_costs.quote: • Operational Excellence: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: The consolidated year-to-date gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.
margins_costs.quote: From the current year-to-date, our consolidated gross margin stands at 8.45%, up 245 basis points from 6% in FY24.

margins_costs.claim: Interest expenses currently account for 1.25% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: Today, interest expenses account for 1.25% of sales, which is a significant drag.

margins_costs.claim: The FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Our FY26 PAT margin stands at 4.5%.

orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The merchandising team onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains in record time.
orders_capacity.quote: • Global Market Penetration: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 1.2-ton.
orders_capacity.quote: 1.2-ton capacity we have, we are 650 kg last quarter exit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

capital_allocation.claim: Beginning FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends declared from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stands at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital days successfully dropped from 71 days for the quarter ended March 25 to 59 days for the quarter ended March 26.
capital_allocation.quote: And our net working capital days have successfully dropped from 71 days for quarter ended March '25 to 59 days for this quarter ended March 26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains nil GML outstanding as of March end while having INR170 crores of GML facility sanctioned.
capital_allocation.quote: And that is why as of March end, our GML outstanding is nil, but we have INR170 crores of GML facility sanctioned with us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve its revenue target of INR8,100 crores by FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning in FY27, the company will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model where remuneration is linked entirely to dividends declared from operating cash flow.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries starting from FY27, aligning payouts solely through dividends.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve revenue of approximately 8,100 crore for FY27.
The company aims to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.
management_commitments.quote: Growth will be funded strictly through internal cash generation to achieve a net debt-free balance sheet by FY30.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reduce net debt by over 50% in FY27 through land sale and operational improvement.
management_commitments.quote: We would be reducing net debt by 50% above in FY27 itself through land sale and operational improvement.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a consistent conversion of 20% to 25% of PAT into operating cash flow.
management_commitments.quote: Our model targets a consistent conversion of 20% to 25% of PAT into operating cash flow, underscoring a lean, high velocity growth engine that is rare among high- growth Indian enterprises.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to monetize the current land and encash it by August end or September last.
management_commitments.quote: We are expecting it by August end. I think August or September last, we will encash it.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
